title: Square’s new kiosk lets you talk to AI for help with your order
hook_text: Square just launched a talking kiosk.
script:
Square is launching a brand new hardware device called the Square Kiosk.
It features a large pill shape design with a built-in touchscreen.
The device includes an agentic conversational voice layer powered by AI.
This voice system fully understands a seller menu.
It listens to customers and responds to their order requests.
Would you order your food from this kiosk?
